expectations.assertion: Requires a clean install from the produced tarball in an environment that does not have the development toolchain on PATH
expectations.reason: The agent never got to a clean install; it stopped because no tarball was found and Bash was unavailable, and it only listed the install as a requirement for the user to supply.

expectations.assertion: Inspects the package contents (what is actually inside the tarball)
expectations.reason: The agent did not inspect any tarball; it reported that dist/ was missing and asked the user for a `tar tzf` listing instead.

expectations.assertion: Runs a smoke test of the primary command from that clean install
expectations.reason: No smoke test was run; the agent stated it had no shell and no artifact to test.

expectations.assertion: States suite results as numbers (passed / skipped), not as the word green
expectations.reason: The agent gave no suite counts at all; it only said the user's claim that the suite passed does not count as verification and asked for the numbers.

expectations.assertion: Names in the affirmative what was not done (not published, not tagged, not pushed)
expectations.reason: The agent affirmatively stated that nothing has been published, installed or run, though it did not mention tagging or pushing specifically.
